preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products n and the modulus m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden_prefix_products) if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: If there are forbidden prefix products, each is between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(forbidden_prefix_products)) == n if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: If there are forbidden prefix products, they are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.
All prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(x not in forbidden_prefix_products for x in prefix_products(sequence, m))
preconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears as an element of the input list.
The length of the sequence is maximized.

postconditions.description: The output length is the sum of the number of forbidden prefix products and the number of elements in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(sequence[i] * sequence[i+1] % m not in prefix_products(sequence[:i+1], m) for i in range(len(sequence) - 1))
postconditions.description: The sequence is constructed such that no prefix product modulo m appears as an element of the input list and all prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct.

invariants.expression: sequence == [] or all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
invariants.description: The sequence is built up with elements between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.
The sequence is constructed such that all prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct.

invariants.expression: sequence == [] or all(x not in forbidden_prefix_products for x in prefix_products(sequence, m))
invariants.description: The sequence is constructed such that no prefix product modulo m appears as an element of the input list.
